digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync primary command routing and compatibility adapters
propositions: Canonical preview/sync CLI and engine routes must normalize through a shared core execution path while preserving legacy reconcile/--mode/--filter-local-ids adapters with their documented defaults and numeric behavior
Legacy --filter-local-ids filters writes post-differ while canonical --only/--except narrow differ inputs pre-execution; both routes must coexist without collapsing distinct filtering semantics

Unresolvable --only/--except tokens and targets that disappear between preflight and locked load must exit 2, name the missing IDs, and never acquire lock or invoke differ/applier/manifest/persistence seams

Argument-less rebar reconcile remains dry-run; direct-engine --mode and argument-less live default remain functional; library rebar.reconcile() and MCP reconcile tool retain their historical defaults and mode-gate behavior
Bridge sync --max-changes applies deterministic applied/deferred partition manifests for specified caps while uncapped live and legacy bootstrap behavior remain unchanged

Production workflow retains reconcile-check as a lock-free diagnostic while mapping dry-run/bootstrap-strict/bootstrap-throttle/live to canonical preview/sync/10-cap/100-cap/live; all three legacy entrypoints (CLI, direct-engine, library/MCP) remain shippable with their prior functional paths
